owner_section_changes: Studio Visuals: the verified account can replace or restore the cover and Canvas of catalogue titles and albums, and the photo and portrait of catalogue artists (title menu, album page, artist page, Studio home).
Overrides are stored apart from the catalogue (ketvoice_media_overrides) and never modify or delete catalogue data.
known_limitations: Owner-section changes are deliberately not mentioned in the public release notes (owner preference).
Overrides are matched by normalised title, album and main-artist names, so a differently spelled release of the same title is not covered.
A Canvas link is downloaded by the device, then sent; the server never fetches a link it is given.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
